title: Implement Memory Intermediator synthesis stage, inner monologue persistence, and cue-change gating

sections.what: Add the dedicated Memory Intermediator synthesis stage between sensory observations/involuntary recall and Actor planning on getMemoryLLMClient(), persist synthesized conscious memory plus inner monologue after cognition, and skip redundant synthesis via cue-change gating on unchanged continuation ticks.
sections.why: Sub-slice 1 of task-947: decouples recollection synthesis from Actor turn-start/end prompting while avoiding extra LLM latency on unchanged continuation ticks.
sections.how: Orchestrate current observations + multi-hop involuntary recall (engine/memory_retrieval.py) -> Intermediator synthesis on getMemoryLLMClient() (task-909) -> Actor cognition -> persist synthesized conscious summary + inner monologue with reinforcement/invalidation feedback to engine/memory_dynamics.py.
sections.verify: Run Intermediator synthesis and cue-change gating tests verifying unchanged continuation ticks reuse cached synthesis and post-turn synthesis persists conscious summary plus inner monologue.

acceptance.text: Intermediator stage synthesizes conscious memory from current observations and involuntary recall on getMemoryLLMClient()
Cue-change gating skips re-synthesis when no significant observation or recall cue shifts between continuation ticks
Both synthesized conscious memory and Actor inner monologue persist back into memory storage with dynamics feedback
